description:
Animated music video for Photon Maiden's A lot of life. The track was used as the coupling track for their first single "Discover Universe". It was also featured as an insert song in several episodes of the D4DJ First Mix anime.

Note: This music video initially released on the D4DJ's official YouTube on July 20, 2020, but was re-uploaded again with a CM recut on October 23, 2020. It was later published standalone also through D4DJ's Global Channel on September 14, 2022.
